div.x > span: descendant-or-self::div[@class and contains(@class, 'x') and contains(concat(' ', normalize-space(@class), ' '), ' x ')]/span
p:not(.y): descendant-or-self::p[not(@class and contains(@class, 'y') and contains(concat(' ', normalize-space(@class), ' '), ' y '))]
span.p1: descendant-or-self::span[@class and contains(@class, 'p1') and contains(concat(' ', normalize-space(@class), ' '), ' p1 ')]
p[class~='lead']: descendant-or-self::p[@class and contains(@class, 'lead') and contains(concat(' ', normalize-space(@class), ' '), ' lead ')]
input:checked: descendant-or-self::input[(@selected and name(.) = 'option') or (@checked and (name(.) = 'input' or name(.) = 'command')and (@type = 'checkbox' or @type = 'radio'))]
input:disabled:
descendant-or-self::input[
        (
            @disabled and
            (
                name(.) = 'input' or
                name(.) = 'button' or
                name(.) = 'select' or
                name(.) = 'textarea' or
                name(.) = 'fieldset' or
                name(.) = 'optgroup' or
                name(.) = 'option'
            )
        ) or (
            (
                name(.) = 'input' or
                name(.) = 'button' or
                name(.) = 'select' or
                name(.) = 'textarea'
            )
            and ancestor::fieldset[@disabled] and not(count(ancestor::legend | ancestor::fieldset[@disabled]/legend[1]) < count(ancestor::legend) + count(ancestor::fieldset[@disabled]/legend[1]))
        ) or (
            name(.) = 'option' and ancestor::optgroup[@disabled]
        )
        ]
a:link: descendant-or-self::a[@href and (name(.) = 'a' or name(.) = 'link' or name(.) = 'area')]
div.a.b: descendant-or-self::div[(@class and contains(@class, 'a') and contains(concat(' ', normalize-space(@class), ' '), ' a ')) and (@class and contains(@class, 'b') and contains(concat(' ', normalize-space(@class), ' '), ' b '))]
